name: floral-bird-panel-left
prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: supplied image containing five separate vertical medieval ornaments. Extract exactly ONE specified ornament as a faithful transparent PNG. Preserve its entire full-length painted silhouette, outer frame, both top and bottom finials or flourishes, all tiny internal birds/butterflies/flowers, olive-gold painted panel background when present, original proportions, aged gold paint texture, colors, and fine ink lines. Remove only the pale parchment OUTSIDE the selected ornament and the other four ornaments. Keep the gold/olive rectangular interior opaque because it belongs to the ornament; make all surroundings true alpha-transparent. For the spiral column preserve all original painted bands and details. Do not add decorations, alter the design, simplify, clip finials, add drop shadows or backing, or repeat the ornament. Output one complete tall narrow ornament centered with minimal transparent margin and tight framing around its actual narrow width. Exact selection: FIRST / far-left ornament, with rounded scroll finials, olive-gold painted interior, roses, blue/purple flowers, butterflies, and small birds
